top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a specific, independently confirmed discovery chain (GLP-1 physiology and secretion, the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form, receptor and tissue biology) whose consequence is validated by large randomized outcome trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity, so maturity is not in doubt. The three-name allocation to Holst, Drucker and Mojsov fits the discovery-anchored citation. The costs are the exclusion of Knudsen and Mojsov's contested priority against early peptide workers, which the record cannot settle, but they do not outweigh the achievement, and no award is clearly worse.
